MISSION THE TENDER'S WAKE
SITUATION OPAREA: Offshore Petropavlovsk. Don-class tender Magadansky Komsomolets is routing toward a guarded rendezvous.
MISSION Track Magadansky Komsomolets, then withdraw.
EXECUTION Track the tender to the rendezvous, record its route, and withdraw without compromising the patrol.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT No weapons release. Do not reveal the patrol while tracking the tender.
FRIENDLY FORCES USS Los Angeles is the flagship and must survive. USS Drum and USS San Francisco are assigned; their losses do not end the operation.
SUPPORT No surface or air unit is under player control. Manage weapons and damage for the next patrol.
